summary.goal: Define IdeationConfig, IdeationOutcome, PlanQualitySignal, and IdeationBaseline domain types with Zod schemas, defaults, and ideation-specific stability constants

acceptance_criteria.description: IdeationConfig schema with: interviewer { model, max_tokens, temperature }, specialist_spawning { early_spawn_rules[], deprioritized[] }, confidence_calibration { exploring_value, forming_value, confident_value }, readiness_advisory { min_conversation_turns, min_specialist_coverage, min_curated_blocks }, version, updated_at
DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG matches current hardcoded values: model='claude-sonnet-4-20250514', maxTokens=4096, temperature=0.7, exploring=25, forming=50, confident=90

IdeationOutcome schema with: session_id, plan_id, session_duration_seconds, conversation_turns, specialists_spawned[], specialist_contributions{}, blocks_total, blocks_curated, blocks_user_edited, avg_block_confidence, is_first_send, send_number, understanding_field_count, timestamp, source

PlanQualitySignal schema with: plan_id, session_id, questions_asked, questions_hard_blocking, versions_before_approval, improvements_suggested, improvements_accepted, blocks_received, blocks_mapped_to_steps, time_to_approval_seconds (nullable), timestamp, source

IdeationBaseline schema with: pattern, mean_questions_per_plan, stddev_questions, mean_versions_before_approval, stddev_versions, mean_block_utilization, stddev_block_utilization, mean_conversation_turns, stddev_conversation_turns, specialist_contribution_rates{}, Welford m2 fields, sample_count, last_updated
Extend parameterType union with: ideation_model, ideation_confidence, ideation_spawning, ideation_readiness. Uses standard cool-down default (24h via getCoolDownPeriod switch default).
Same stability thresholds as all other packages: burn-in=50, min_samples=30, max_ci_width=0.10, improvement_margin=0.15. Use testbench for training data if ideation needs to hit burn-in faster.

steps.title: Create IdeationConfig schema and defaults
steps.description: Create packages/tuner/src/domain/ideation-config.ts with Zod schemas for IdeationConfig, InterviewerConfig, SpecialistSpawning, ConfidenceCalibration, ReadinessAdvisory, and SpawnRule. Export DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG with current hardcoded values.

acceptance_criteria.description: IdeationConfigSchema exports type and const DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG
Defaults match: model='claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens=4096, temperature=0.7, exploring=25, forming=50, confident=90
All nested schemas (Interviewer, SpecialistSpawning, etc.) have defaults

steps.title: Create IdeationOutcome schema
steps.description: Create packages/tuner/src/domain/ideation-outcome.ts with IdeationOutcomeSchema and SpecialistContributionSchema. Covers session metrics, specialist activity, block metrics, handoff context.

acceptance_criteria.description: IdeationOutcomeSchema includes session_id, plan_id, duration, conversation_turns
SpecialistContributionSchema has observations_count, insights_queued, blocks_created, final_confidence
specialist_contributions is z.record(z.string(), SpecialistContributionSchema)

steps.title: Create PlanQualitySignal schema
steps.description: Create packages/tuner/src/domain/plan-quality-signal.ts with PlanQualitySignalSchema. Measures clarification burden, revision burden, block utilization from Planner approval.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanQualitySignalSchema includes plan_id, session_id, questions_asked, questions_hard_blocking
Schema includes versions_before_approval, improvements_suggested, improvements_accepted
Schema includes blocks_received, blocks_mapped_to_steps, time_to_approval_seconds (nullable)

steps.title: Create IdeationBaseline schema
steps.description: Create packages/tuner/src/domain/ideation-baseline.ts with IdeationBaselineSchema. Follows EMA + Welford pattern, includes specialist_contribution_rates.

acceptance_criteria.description: Schema includes mean/stddev fields for questions, versions, block_utilization, conversation_turns
Schema includes specialist_contribution_rates as z.record(z.string(), z.number())
Schema includes Welford m2 fields for variance tracking

architecture.pattern: Follows TaskBaseline pattern with Welford state

steps.title: Extend stability config with ideation parameters
steps.description: Extend parameterType union in stability.ts with ideation types. No ideation-specific thresholds — uses same DEFAULT_STABILITY_CONFIG as Forge/Planner. The existing getCoolDownPeriod() default case maps unknown types to model_selection_ms (24h), which is appropriate for all ideation parameters.

acceptance_criteria.description: parameterType union extended with 'ideation_model' | 'ideation_confidence' | 'ideation_spawning' | 'ideation_readiness'
No changes to DEFAULT_STABILITY_CONFIG scalar values (burn_in=50, min_samples=30, max_ci_width=0.10)
getCoolDownPeriod() default case handles new types via fallthrough to model_selection_ms (24h)

architecture.pattern: Extend parameterType union only, no new constants

steps.title: Export all ideation domain types
steps.description: Add exports to packages/tuner/src/domain/index.ts for all new ideation types and schemas

acceptance_criteria.description: All new schemas and types exported from domain/index.ts
TypeScript builds without errors
